fields.name: air_carrier_name
fields.description: Certificate holder responsible for the aircraft.

fields.name: maintenance_record_number
fields.description: Maintenance record or work order covered by the release.

fields.name: maintenance_manual_compliance
fields.description: Certification that work followed the certificate holder's manual.

fields.name: required_inspections_completed
fields.description: Certification that required inspections were completed by authorized persons.

fields.name: known_unairworthy_condition
fields.description: Whether any known condition would make the aircraft unairworthy.

fields.name: safe_operation_condition
fields.description: Certification that the aircraft is in condition for safe operation as to the work performed.

fields.name: return_to_service_status
fields.description: Authorized, withheld, or conditional return-to-service status.

fields.name: authorized_mechanic_name
fields.description: Authorized certificated mechanic, repairman, or repair-station signer.

fields.name: authorized_mechanic_certificate_number
fields.description: Certificate or authorization identifier for the signer.

fields.name: release_signature
fields.description: Controlled electronic or physical signature reference.

fields.name: release_signed_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the release or log entry was signed.

fields.name: pilot_in_command_copy_provided
fields.description: Whether a copy of the airworthiness release was provided to the pilot in command.

fields.name: record_retain_until
fields.description: Minimum retention date for the release record.

fields.name: compliance_status
fields.description: Evidence-backed release completeness status; the authorized signer retains release authority.
